newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - RF Micro Devices.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - RF Micro Devices.

text.p: Hambrecht and Quist analyst Eric Zimits said he initiated coverage of RF Micro Devices with a buy recommendation.

-- "The company is the only supplier of FaAs HBT components for commercial applications. This process technology has distinct advantages over silicon and other GaAs technologies for higher frequency wireless applications," Zimits said in a research report.
-- He projected earnings per share will nearly double to $0.50 per share in calendar year 1998, and long term growth should exceed 30 percent annually.
